description: Determine whether a given integer n is divisible by 11. Return true if n is a multiple of 11 (this includes 0 and negative multiples such as -22) and false otherwise.
notes: VERINA states the postcondition with quantifiers over k (result -> exists k, n = 11 * k; not result -> forall k, n != 11 * k). Both specs use the equivalent remainder test n % 11 == 0, which the verifier can decide on concrete inputs.
